description: PutCustomDomain checks that the domain points at the distribution's managed domain and rejects the call when it does not (the spec's `skipDnsCheck` text: `If this is not the case, the call would usually reject`). The spec's error body, GenericJsonResponse, lists `details[].key`, and `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_CNAME_MISSING` is one of its enum values. A caller retries this one while DNS propagates: STACKIT's Terraform acceptance test blocks until the CNAME resolves before adding the domain (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/cdn/cdn_acc_test.go, `blockUntilDomainResolves`, read 2026-11-01). Typed from the body key so it stands apart from other 422s, without a status because the spec doesn't say which one carries it. No live probe. Listed first: a tie with UnprocessableEntity's bare status matcher goes to the class declared first.
